---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Goal: compare Packett GO annotation to original

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Load GOs
```{r}
genome_GOs <- read_delim("../../shared/input/Crichardii_676_v2.1.annotation_info.txt") %>%
  select(peptideName, GO_genome = GO)

head(genome_GOs)
tail(genome_GOs)
dim(genome_GOs)
```

```{r}
Plackett_GOs <- read_tsv("../../shared/input/Cr_GO_Plackett_clean.tsv") %>%
  rename(peptideName = Cr_peptideName, GO_Plackett = All_GO)
head(Plackett_GOs)
dim(Plackett_GOs)
```

merge them
```{r}
GOs <- genome_GOs %>% full_join(Plackett_GOs)
GOs
```

```{r}
GOs %>%
  summarize(across(starts_with("GO"), \(x) sum(is.na(x))))
```

```{r}
GOs %>%
  summarize(across(starts_with("GO"), \(x) mean(str_count(x,"GO"), na.rm=TRUE), .names = "{.col}_count"))
```
So these are not wildly different
